exactPrompt:
Paint three ORIGINAL transparent west-facing walking sprites of our exact Mountain Guardian in three equally wide cells, all same size and same camera. Ref 1 is his exact WEST idle identity, refs 2 and 3 are the exact motion poses (TOP row only); refs 4 and 5 are only the painted Chinese Daoist Q finishing style. One purple-brown eye, dark brown updo with sage ribbon, ivory puff trousers and gold-trimmed dark boots, teal embroidered robe, a single near-side jade round shield with gold edging and tassel, and single upright gold ring staff held in the far hand on the LEFT near the face. Stay strict left-facing side profile, keep both held props fully visible and in their original hands. 
Use the staff as a spatial cue for the lead shoe. In ALL THREE drawings, place the rear shoe (on screen RIGHT) slightly higher, and the front shoe nearest the staff on the LOWER baseline of the figure. First pose f12: feet very close, both attached; tiny visible edge of the far shoe just ahead of the near boot so both shoes can be discerned. Normal open eye. Second pose f13: staff-side leading boot heel visibly TOUCHES LOWEST BASELINE; only that boot's toe tips up a small amount, not the whole boot. The trailing boot to the RIGHT should be almost level but completely HIGHER on the canvas than the front shoe heel, with a short puff trouser leg still visible. Third pose f14: staff-side lead boot stays low and now lies FLAT, the right rear heel has lifted and bent clearly backward, only rear toe a little above the front sole. Walk gait not running or kicking. Shift shield back slightly during f13 and f14. At no point in this strip should the trailing shoe be lower than the leading heel. Keep head height and all prop sizes unchanged. Have 12 percent clear alpha gutters, all props inside their cell. True alpha, no floor, background, shadows, text, visual effects or grid.
